messages.message: Tangents are not used because the material has no normal texture.

views.front: The back cushion and circular footrest now have visible metal connections; the original upholstered stool silhouette is retained.
views.rear: Full-size rear confirms two mounts connect the seat structure into the back, with the foot ring braced to all four legs.
views.detail: Ring joints and the metal frame read coherently. Localized white cover puckering at the front corners remains a modest limitation, not an unsupported part.
views.underside: The ring braces connect within the four-legged base; all glides and the closed seat underside remain present.
views.clay: Uncolored view confirms actual back and ring support geometry, a visible construction improvement at application scale.
